caption: Upgrade to Pro in euros: 9 euro a month billed yearly for 500 subscribers and 10,000 emails, the same figure as the $9 in our dossier. The organisation name is hidden.
At 2,500 subscribers Pro rises to $18 a month billed yearly, with 25,000 emails. The 10,000 email figure only holds at 500 subscribers.
Our second form was refused: the free plan, called Starter in the app, allows one form. Pro at 10 euro billed monthly lifts that limit. The organisation name is hidden.
Our inline sign-up form was ready in about 5 minutes. On the free plan it carries Powered by EmailOctopus. The account first name is hidden.

Saving a campaign with a sender on example.com raised a DMARC warning: EmailOctopus would send from an address on its own domain instead. We chose Continue and sent nothing. The support avatar is hidden.
The bottom of our Announce template preview: the unsubscribe line, EmailOctopus' placeholder return address and the Sent with EmailOctopus badge of the free plan.
